title: Unique Friend | Ruibo Data Pushes Ops+Business Integration SaaS into Snack & QSR Chains
summary: Interview with Jiangsu Ruibo Data (睿博数据) — restaurant-chain ops SaaS fusing cloud/big data with franchise lifecycle tools: Shuaishou Zhanggui (full-link POS/order/cash & goods data), Hui Yunying (SOP→train→inspect→analyze→optimize loop; smart store-check, e-SOP, build-out,
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Unique Friend / Insight · November 17, 2022

Interview with Jiangsu Ruibo Data (睿博数据) — restaurant-chain ops SaaS fusing cloud/big data with franchise lifecycle tools: Shuaishou Zhanggui (full-link POS/order/cash & goods data), Hui Yunying (SOP→train→inspect→analyze→optimize loop; smart store-check, e-SOP, build-out, training, franchise collab, risk, analytics), and Ruibo Cloud. Serves 2 of China’s 4 restaurant brands with 10k+ stores; logos include Juewei, Mixue, Zhangliang Malatang, Shuyi, ChaBaiDao, Jixiang Wonton, Xijie Fried Skewers — ~40% of 1,000+ store brands; >150,000 stores. 2022 rev +30% YoY, profit +10%. Cumulative financing >¥80M (Jisheng, Zhengtong Electronics, Swiftpass, Ruipeng); new strategic round open — Unique Capital FA. Team from KFC/McD/Juewei.

2022: ops+business integration mid-platform; entered snack/QSR (Xijie, Heshan Yuan, Huaidian Wangpo Prawn…). Cases: Suge Fresh Fruit Tea (~200 stores) — cloud inspect cuts supervisor review 2h→30min/day (~60 person-days/mo at 200-store scale); 100% training completion; Mazhuazhua (卤味) 18→300 Chongqing stores, 40M+ chicken feet/yr via Hui Yunying talent/SOP. ~¥10M R&D to push data-mid capability to store edge (千店千面). Next: franchise infra across chains; multi-10M industrial capital round.

— END —
